title: Duplicate File Cleanup
desc: Scan and clean duplicate files in your storage to free up space

scan.tips: 💡 Tip: Deduplication groups by size first, then verifies with content Hash. Scanning is read-only and safe. Deletions require explicit confirmation.
scan.no_hash_hint: {{count}} files could not be fast-hashed by storage driver, grouped as candidates

result.empty: No duplicate files found, storage is clean 🎉
result.candidate_warning: ⚠️ Candidate items are matched only by name and size without Hash verification. Please manually check before deleting!
result.keep_last_hint: Must keep at least 1 copy per group
result.search_placeholder: Search file name, path or hash...

clean.title: Confirm Duplicate File Cleanup
clean.desc: About to permanently delete {{count}} duplicate files
clean.remove_empty_dirs: Remove empty parent directories after cleaning
clean.warning: ⚠️ Deletion is irreversible, please proceed with caution!

folders.title: Duplicate Folders Recognition & Merge
folders.desc: Automatically list folder pairs with >30% file duplication, supporting one-click merge and cleanup
folders.modal_desc: Merge contents of two folders into one, automatically deleting duplicates and migrating unique files
folders.select_target: Select the target directory to keep:
folders.strategy_label: Name collision strategy for different files:
folders.warning_tip: After merging, duplicate files in the source directory will be permanently deleted, unique files will be moved to the target directory, and the empty source directory will be removed.
folders.merge_success: Merge complete: deleted {{deleted}} duplicates, moved {{moved}} unique files, reclaimed {{reclaimed}}
